name: ClearPost Simple AI Auto Post | Create Content with AI
author: purposego

sections.description:
Imagine posting great content every day. Watch as the AI learns your site, then automatically researches and schedules posts to fit your SEO plan. Generate draft posts in one click with native formatting. See your full prompt history to reuse your best prompts. Use any of the top AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. Automatically embed links (perfect for directories).

No more copy-pasting from ChatGPT. Generate content directly as WordPress Gutenberg blocks with proper formatting. Focus on creating more great content that people actually want to read – not on tedious copy-pasting and fiddling with formatting.

All your past prompts, automatically saved. Experiment with different prompt styles to get different results, and then easily come back to what works. Your best prompt of all time is a click away.

Free forever. All core features of this plugin are free with your own AI provider API keys: Generate posts with no limits, with full prompt history saved, and chat with AI to have it automatically edit your posts faster than ever. An optional premium add-on allows you to leverage our AI content analysis agent that indexes your site to ensure new posts fit your established style effortlessly.

Create better content, faster, for free

We initially built this plugin to generate high-quality content for our own directory site. As a result, we saw meaningful growth in SEO traffic as we could target more and more long-tail keywords in our niche. Seeing these results firsthand, we realized other WordPress sites could benefit from this technology too.

Free Version Features (Free Forever)

  • Generate draft posts in one click – use OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini with your own API key
  • Chat to edit with AI – just ask the AI to edit your post from inside the post editor, and watch the changes get applied automatically
  • Generate directly as Gutenberg blocks – no copy-paste needed, posts look great immediately
  • Support for all top AI models – choose from OpenAI’s GPTs, Anthropic’s Claude, or Google’s Gemini models
  • Prompt history – recycle and refine winning prompts fast
  • Choose your post type – generate posts of any kind, even custom post types
  • Preview before publishing – new posts generate in draft mode for easy review
  • Embed a link in each post – the AI can put links in ACF fields too

Premium Version Features (Totally Optional)

AI that knows your style – Go further, faster with our Site Context AI Agent.

  • Site Context AI agent – scans and indexes your existing posts to understand your unique voice, formatting patterns, style, and topics, for 10x more relevant results – instantly.
  • Your style, reproduced effortlessly – the agent creates custom AI instructions based on your site’s existing content, so new posts automatically match your established style. Replaces hours of frustrating prompt engineering.
  • Autonomous prompt scheduling – schedule posts to generate automatically while you sleep.
  • Maintain control – you can edit the AI-created system prompts for fine-grained control over how new posts come out.
  • Predictable price for AI usage – for a simple, predictable monthly subscription, with no nasty surprises from usage-based AI provider invoices.
  • Premium support

ClearPost will always be free to use. Our premium cloud service gives users access to advanced features that require intensive processing on our servers.

How It Works

  1. Setup: Enter your OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key, choose your AI model, choose your post type, and write a prompt for the post you want to create.

  2. Generate: Click “Generate Post” to create a draft post with Gutenberg blocks and optional links.

  3. Review and Edit with AI: Ask your AI copilot to make an edit and watch it edit your post in real time.

  4. Publish when you’re ready: You remain in full control of the Publish button.

  5. Click to Reuse a Prompt: Did that prompt work well? Browse your prompt history and click to use it again.

Focused on solving a single problem well

ClearPost is built for a specific, powerful purpose: To massively augment your content creation workflow so you can achieve your goals faster.

Our goal is to take away the tedious drudgery of content creation and help you stay more focused on what you do best: Craft content your audience will love.

Accelerate your content creation lead times

What’s blocking you now:
* Drafts stay unfinished because you’re running the whole site.
* A couple of posts a month can’t outrank sites that publish daily.
* Freelancers cost more than the revenue you’re trying to earn.

Imagine a simple way to use AI to accelerate your workflow. Drop a prompt, click Generate, and watch as Gutenberg blocks fill up with great content that fits your style and voice. Set up a week’s worth of drafts in a coffee break.

Picture your analytics one month from now:
* A fresh article goes live every single day.
* Search impressions climb, clicks follow, conversions roll in.
* Competitors wonder how you suddenly outpace their content teams.

With ClearPost, that future starts now.

Big update! Post maps, inline images, new models, formatting improvements, and more

Post map formulas
* You can now add, edit, and reuse post maps to guide the AI to create posts in your specific format.
* Just drop in a link to the post you want to mimic, and the AI will create an editable post map structure to guide new posts.
* When you create a new post, just choose the relevant post type from your saved library of post maps.
* Make newly generated posts fit your exact style. Copy the style of any article, from anywhere, effortlessly.

Inline image placement
* Automatically add on-brand inline images into the right sections of each post, using your post maps to decide where visuals belong.
* Images are fetched from Google Images and inserted in the background after generation, so your drafts stay fast to create while still looking polished and ready to publish.

Gemini 3, GPT 5.1, Claude Sonnet and Opus 4.5
* Now the latest, most powerful AI models are available to use in ClearPost.
* Use the longform power of Claude Opus 4.5, or the research intelligence of Gemini 3, or the adaptability of GPT 5.1.

Better SEO Strategy and Keywords
* You now get an improved SEO strategy to drive better results.
* Your plan presents refined target keywords – which you can edit for maximum precision.

Even more improvements
* Models are now enabled to search the internet for sources. The AI will find relevant sources and link them (or not, depending on your settings).
* Tables are now supported inside posts. LLMs love to output tables because they make data easier to digest. Now you can publish tables in your articles!
* Added markdown support in the AI post editor chat, for easier reading. This includes links!
* Fixed a formatting issue in newly generated posts.

1.0

  • Initial release
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clearpost-simple-ai-auto-post folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘AI Auto Post’ Settings page to configure your AI provider API keys and other options
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the core functionality is forever free to use with your own AI provider API keys. The optional premium add-on offers advanced AI content analysis, site context architecture, and scheduling features that require intensive processing on our servers.

Do I need an API key to use this plugin?

The free version requires you to obtain an API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google. Premium users do not need to input their own AI provider API keys.

Can I customize the generated content?

Yes, you can customize the prompt used for content generation in the plugin settings. Premium users get AI-generated system prompts that automatically match your site’s style.

Does this plugin support custom post types?

Yes, you can select any public post type as the target for generated content, whatever your custom theme or setup uses.

Does this plugin allow me to embed links in the generated content?

Yes, you can embed URL links in the generated content by selecting an ACF field or other link field. The AI will automatically add the link to the selected field – perfect for directory listings or product reviews.

Is this plugin suitable for directory sites?

Yes, ClearPost works exceptionally well for directory sites. It can quickly create directory posts with embedded links, making it ideal for creating great directory content.

How does this plugin help with SEO?

By making it more feasible to create great content targeting specific, niche, long-tail keywords, ClearPost allows you to help searchers looking for just the specific thing you’re posting about.

What’s the difference between this and other AI content generators?

ClearPost is focused completely on accelerating your content creation workflow, with no fluff or unnecessary extras. Have AI generate your first draft in Gutenberg blocks, then revise and publish. Quickly reuse and refine winning prompts.

Don’t waste time or add site overhead with unnecessary AI features – get just what you need to accelerate your content creation.

What additional features do I get with the Premium version?

The Premium version includes AI that knows your style:
* Site Context AI agent – scans and indexes your existing posts to understand your unique voice, formatting patterns, style, and topics.
* Autonomous prompt scheduling – schedule posts to generate automatically while you sleep.
* Your style, reproduced effortlessly – the agent creates custom AI instructions based on your site’s existing content, so new posts automatically match your established style. Replaces hours of frustrating prompt engineering.
* Maintain control – you can edit the AI-created system prompts for fine-grained control over how new posts come out.
* Predictable price for AI usage – for a simple, predictable monthly subscription, with no nasty surprises from usage-based AI provider invoices.
* Premium support

How does the Premium version’s content analysis work?

The content analysis AI agent scans and indexes your existing posts to understand your unique voice, formatting patterns, style, and topics. It then creates custom AI instructions so new posts automatically match your established style, saving you from prompt engineering for every post.
